name: Ridge day
story: A brisk west-southwest wind across the island all day: lift on every windward face, rough air in the lee and on short final into the valley strips. Crosswind practice at the club; glider pilots' heaven.
forecast: West-southwest 15 kt, gusting 22 over the hills, 18 kt early afternoon. Moderate turbulence in the lee of the ridges. Fair-weather cumulus, base 1200 m. Wind easing at dusk; broken cloud at night, the moon between.
